requirements.description: Execucomp annual compensation source used by the separate internal/external CEO classification program.

routes.description: The local Execucomp annual-compensation candidate passed the bounded read for the requested source fields listed below. The code forms the long-window output from 1993–2020 and rolling outputs for z=2003–2020 with y=z−10. It generates lag variables, but its classification conditions permit missing lags and count them; no earlier source period is required solely to make all lags nonmissing. The one-row read does not establish coverage for the code's stated years.
routes.expected_period: The code uses 1993–2020 for its long-window output and z=2003–2020 with y=z−10 for rolling outputs. Missing lags are permitted and counted by the supplied classification conditions; no earlier input years are inferred as mandatory. Coverage over the code's stated source-relative years remains unverified.

requirements.description: ISS voting recommendations (`EP.issrec`) joined to the selected Voting Analytics observations by company, meeting and agenda item to create issrec/issfor.

The custom Equilar Additional Share Request workbook (`Equilar_plans.xlsx`) supplies plan proposal dates, requested and available/outstanding share counts, approval/new-plan status, votes, company identifiers and plan names. It is imported and normalized into EP.equity_plans.

The custom Equilar annual equity-grant workbook (`Equilar_grants.xlsx`) supplies the three FY-end dates, CIK and vendor-coded annual grant/run-rate/depletion/conversion measures used to form EP.equity_grants.

The author-named ISS Equity Plan Scorecard file (`epsc.dta`) supplies company/meeting/plan identifiers, plan flexibility attributes, duration and ticker used to construct planflex and align it to plan requests.
The Ertimur et al. (2018) state noncompete index workbook (`Ertimur_NCA.xlsx`) supplies year1, year2, state and score; the code changes year2=2013 to 2100 before joining to plan-request years.
The StateNames.csv crosswalk supplies state abbreviation (`code`) to full-state-name (`state`) mapping between Compustat company state and the noncompete workbook.

issues.description: The frozen header records Do U.S. Investors Value Foreign Component Auditors? (10.1111/1475-679X.12412), while the author datasheet identifies Equity Compensation Plans and Board of Director Discretion over Equity Grants by Brian Cadman and Richard Carrizosa. The supplied Equilar, ISS, Execucomp, CRSP, BoardEx and equity-plan code belongs to the datasheet's distinct subject. Keep frozen metadata unchanged and assess this actual package without attributing its workflow or results to the registered foreign-auditor paper.

The native source programs name multiple prepared files, vendor extracts, WRDS inputs and an FFI12/FFI48 classification handoff, while the archive inventory contains only code, a datasheet and two identifier lists. Their compatible fields, periods, file schemas, roots and several producer/consumer handoffs are not yet established.

Equity_Grant_Sample.sas and Equity_Plan_Sample.sas both include `[Path2]\ffi12.sas`, which is not in the package inventory. Their FFI12 construction and emitted fields cannot be verified from this archive; FFI12 is subsequently used as an industry classification in the supplied analysis.

Internal_External_CEO.do names `ffind.do` by J. Caskey and calls `ffind SIC, newvar(FFI48) type(48)`, but the macro source is not in the package inventory. The exact FFI48 classification construction is therefore unverified.

The CEO program produces the `FFI48`-keyed insiders_perc panel, while Equity_Plan_Sample.sas calls `%ffi12(sich)` and later joins `A.ffi48` to `B.ffi48`. The missing macro prevents confirming whether it also supplies FFI48 in the plan sample; do not conflate FFI48 with the FFI12 industry variable used in the Stata tests.

The author programs leave Path1, Path2, the CEO global path, the Stata cd and printdir as placeholders. The CEO program also saves perc_insider intermediates relative to the current directory. Configure a coherent host-visible data/macro/output root before a later run so the produced sample and insiders_perc files reach their named consumers.

Ten supplied SAS PROC SQL aggregate clauses are written with `by group`. The official SAS 9.4 SQL reference documents `GROUP BY`; the proposed working-copy edits change only keyword order and preserve each key list, aggregate, join and adjacent ORDER BY. No author program was executed and no syntax failure is claimed.

Ten supplied Stata data reloads use the option `replace`. The current official Stata use manual documents `clear` for replacing the dataset in memory; the proposed edits change only that option and retain every filename. The Stata 18 manual URL could not be retrieved, so this is not a Stata 18-specific execution finding.

evidence.description: The CEO program constructs the 10-year/long-window insider measures by FFI48 and saves insiders_perc.dta.
evidence.quote:
ffind SIC, newvar(FFI48) type(48)	

collapse (sum) internal external, by (FFI48 YEAR)

preserve
collapse (sum) internal_00_14 = internal external_00_14 = external if YEAR>=1993 & YEAR<=2020, by (FFI48)
gen insiders_perc_93_20 = internal_00_14/(internal_00_14+external_00_14)
save perc_insider_93_20, replace
restore

preserve
clear
gen YEAR=1
save perc_insider, replace
restore

local z=2003
while `z'<2021{
	preserve
	local y = `z'-10
	collapse (sum) internal_10yr = internal external_10yr = external if YEAR>=`y' & YEAR<=`z', by (FFI48)
	gen YEAR = `z'
	gen insiders_perc_10yr = internal_10yr/(internal_10yr+external_10yr)

	append using perc_insider
	save perc_insider, replace
	restore
	local z = `z'+1
	}

use perc_insider, clear
merge m:1 FFI48 using perc_insider_93_20 
drop _merge
save "$path/insiders_perc.dta", replace

collapse (sum) internal_00_14 = internal external_00_14 = external if YEAR>=1993 & YEAR<=2020, by (FFI48)
gen insiders_perc_93_20 = internal_00_14/(internal_00_14+external_00_14)

restore

preserve
clear
gen YEAR=1
save perc_insider, replace
restore

local z=2003
while `z'<2021{
	preserve
	local y = `z'-10
	collapse (sum) internal_10yr = internal external_10yr = external if YEAR>=`y' & YEAR<=`z', by (FFI48)
	gen YEAR = `z'
	gen insiders_perc_10yr = internal_10yr/(internal_10yr+external_10yr)

	append using perc_insider
	save perc_insider, replace
	restore
	local z = `z'+1
	}

merge m:1 FFI48 using perc_insider_93_20 
drop _merge
save "$path/insiders_perc.dta", replace
